item.title: Dow Jones Plunges Over 1,100 Points as Iran Conflict Escalates, Oil Surges to Multi-Year Highs

item.title: (VIDEO) Kristi Noem Hearing: Protesters Removed from Senate Hearing Amid Grilling Over Minneapolis Deaths
